en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Renaissance arcaded courtyard. A long façade with repeated round arches on slender columns forms a loggia; above the arches runs an ornate frieze with stucco scrollwork and sculpted heads between the windows. At the center of the upper façade is a circular sundial. The courtyard ground is open and mostly empty, bordered by short posts linked with chains. At the right, the building turns into a corner wing with similarly decorated upper stories and a large arched passageway.
